title: SCHC codec: excellent module documentation
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs lines 1-18

What is good:

The module documentation is exemplary:
1. Clear RFC reference (RFC 8724)
2. Documents the compress/decompress function signatures
3. Explains bit order (MSB-first, zero-padded)
4. Documents no_std compatibility
5. Most notably: Explains WHY compress/decompress are used instead of encode/decode - this is a semantic distinction that prevents future maintainers from incorrectly fixing the naming to match other modules

This is the kind of documentation that prevents incorrect consistency refactors.

Recommendation: Defend this documentation. It should be preserved as-is.
